messages.subject: Re: [poppr] how to plot population ancestry values as DAPC plots?
parts:
I'm not sure how you are expecting to achieve this, but you can plot the Linear Discriminants by extracting them from the DAPC object and plotting them with ggplot2.

I have a (somewhat tortuous) example in a paper I wrote at the end of 2017: https://github.com/everhartlab/sclerotinia-366/blob/master/results/pop-diff.md. You can find the extraction of the DAPC data if you search for `LDS`

Hope that helps
